senses.gloss:
जुट् जुट्, cl. 6. P. जुटति, &c., a various
reading for जुड्, to bind; [cf. जट्.]

जुटक, अम्, n. [cf. जटा and जूटक], a braid of
hair, any knot or fillet of hair; (इका), f. = चूडा, a
tuft of hair on the top of the head; the matted hair
of Śiva or of ascetics.
जूटक, अम्, n. twisted or braided hair; [cf. जटा.]

जूट जूट, अस्, m. the matted hair of Śiva,
the twisted or clotted hair of an ascetic; [cf. जटा
and चूड.]
